params.body:
Three small measurements at once.

| measurement | facet | thresholds, worst first |
| --- | --- | --- |
| domain | expiry | `DOMAIN_EXPIRING_NOW` (<30 days, now), `DOMAIN_EXPIRING` (<60, week), `DOMAIN_VALID` (ok) |
| ci | run | `CI_RED` (week), `CI_GREEN` (ok) |
| ci | coverage | `COVERAGE_LOW` (<40%, background), `COVERAGE_OK` (ok) |
| repo | readme | `README_THIN` (<100 words, background), `README_FULL` (ok) |
| repo | docs | `DOCS_STALE` (>90 days, background), `DOCS_FRESH` (ok) |
| repo | alignment | `DOCS_TRAILING` (background), `DOCS_ALIGNED` (ok) |

Numbers copied from Portal's cards (Domain, Tests and CI, Repo). No verdict where there is nothing to judge: a registry that publishes no expiry, a pipeline without a completed run, a repository without a readme.

Tests: `ThreeSmallJudgesTest` pins the ladders. Suite 616 green, PHPStan and Pint clean.
params.title: Domain, Ci and Repo judge their own facts
